title: Cristalline
description: This mod add an all new mechanic to ametyst by giving the opportunity to grow electricity powered crystals and make new items for survival.
body:
**Cristalline is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that expands on one of the game's most underused mechanics — amethyst crystal growth.**



## What's in :

-Spark Crystal : A rare elemental crystal infused with electrical energy.

-Vigor Cell : A portable energy reactor crafted from Spark Crystals and Copper Ingots. Right-click to unleash an electric discharge that damages nearby entities, applies the Cell Charged effect, and emits a unique particle burst. Holding it in either hand permanently keeps you Cell Charged.

-Cell Charged : A double-edged effect: grants +2 attack damage, but deals damage when submerged in water. Use it wisely.

-Other thinks.. but I'm lazy to put them here.



## -Coming soon:

Elemental crystal growth mechanics tied to amethyst clusters
Bio Shards, Gor Seeds and Gor Soup
Sea Shards (if i'm not lazy)
Custom sounds and particles for each element_



Cristalline aims to build a full elemental progression system around amethyst — this is just the beginning.
